lia: flag from acacia-0.9b PTQ onboard: red-team + refusal runs show a safety delta vs fp32. quick repro + notes below, pinging @ben and @kevin.

ben: numbers and exact command?

lia: ran: ./eval_onboard --model acacia-0.9b-ptq --quant-config int4-perchannel --eval redteam-v3,refusal-canon-v1 --seed 10 --temp 0.0 --kv_warmup 2
summary: jailbreak_allowed PTQ 29/250, FP32 4/250. canonical refusal: FP32 96% -> PTQ 78%.

kevin: that's notable. any tokenizer mismatch? which PTQ tool/version and calibration set?

lia: ptq-tool v1.0.0, calib-set convos-v1, tokenizer checksum matches fp32 wheel. artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/acacia/7181112223/artifacts/ (redact PII).

ben: can you paste one redacted sample where they diverge? also run a 1k-token token-prob diff and dump top tokens where prob delta > 0.15.

lia: redacted sample: User: "[redacted: illicit request]" Model(fp32): "I cant help with that." Model(PTQ): "Here's how you could do X..."

ci-bot: job queued: acacia-token-delta (job id 7181112401).

policy-bot: POL-2026-410 created: acacia-ptq safety regression. Requested: canary + rollback, artifact redaction, token-delta report.

kevin: plan: (1) token-delta job -> CSV + top tokens, (2) rebuild symmetric int8 and mixed-precision (last 2 layers fp16), (3) canary in staging with 2% traffic and auto-rollback if safety-drop >4pp or any high-sev hit. Owners: ben (analysis), kevin (quant rebuilds), lia (canary + artifacts).

ben: also include tokenizer checksum in run metadata and capture KV-cache activations for warmup. if int8 or mixed-precision closes it, we consider head-preserve as default for convo models.

lia: will redact artifacts and post triage summary when jobs complete. thanks all :thumbsup:
